description: Search Bandcamp, fetch albums/tracks/artists/labels by URL, or browse by tag/genre or the discover feed.

albumSlug.description: Album slug — the part after `/album/` in the URL.
albumSlug.title: Album slug (mode=byAlbum)

artistSubdomain.description: Artist subdomain on bandcamp.com (the part before `.bandcamp.com`). Combine with `albumSlug` or `trackSlug` to build a URL.
artistSubdomain.sectionDescription: Slug-based inputs the actor uses to build a Bandcamp URL when you don't pass a full URL.
artistSubdomain.title: Artist subdomain (mode=byArtist/byAlbum/byTrack)

artistUrl.description: Full URL of an artist or label homepage. byArtist reads the profile; byDiscography lists every release on its /music page.
artistUrl.title: Artist or label URL (mode=byArtist/byDiscography)

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If direct fetches return 403/429, retry through Apify proxy automatically.
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate to proxy on block

enrichDiscography.description: For every release in the discography, also open its album/track page to fill tracklists, pricing, tags, and audio links. Slower (one request per release); off uses the fast /music grid.
enrichDiscography.title: Fetch full release details (mode=byDiscography)

genre.description: One of the curated Bandcamp top-level genres. Used by mode=byGenre and mode=discover.
genre.title: Genre (mode=byGenre / discover)

maxPrice.description: Drop records with a listed price above this value. Records without pricing data pass.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop records with a listed price below this value. Records without pricing data pass.
minPrice.sectionDescription: Drop records that don't match these criteria. Records without pricing data pass through min/max price.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

mode.description: What to fetch. Search, fetch by URL, list an artist/label full discography, browse a tag/genre, or read the discover feed.
mode.title: Mode

onlyFree.description: Only emit records that are name-your-price-zero or explicitly free.
onlyFree.title: Only free items

onlyWithAudio.description: Only emit records that have a streamable audio URL or featured track.
onlyWithAudio.title: Audio stream required

query.description: Free-text query for the search modes.
query.title: Search query (mode=search*)

sortBy.description: Sort order for the discover feed.
sortBy.title: Sort (mode=discover)

trackSlug.description: Track slug — the part after `/track/` in the URL.
trackSlug.title: Track slug (mode=byTrack)

url.description: A bandcamp.com URL — album, track, artist subdomain, tag page, search URL, or the discover front page. Used by mode=byUrl/byAlbum/byTrack/byArtist/byDiscography.
url.sectionDescription: URLs (single or batch) plus the keyword used by the search* modes.
url.title: URL

urls.description: Multiple bandcamp.com URLs. Album/track/artist/tag URLs are auto-routed.
urls.title: URLs (mode=byUrl, batch)

useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify proxy. Bandcamp is normally accessible without a proxy.
useProxy.sectionDescription: Optional Apify proxy. Auto-escalation transparently retries through proxy on 403/429.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: Bandcamp Scraper Input
